budgets.charged_scope: subprocess wall time, conservative including setup and validation; builds and fixture copies excluded

consumer_build: incomplete: first baseline compilation completed; BSD time RSS sysctl denied; remaining seven observations not run

counter_scopes.backend: TransferContext logical transfer stats where available; null means unavailable
counter_scopes.codec_cpu: diagnostic only; sum intercepted ZSTD create/free call thread CPU and compress2/decompressStream thread CPU; operation uses process CPU; clock/interposition overhead and unobserved internal calls limit attribution
counter_scopes.libc: interposed read/pread/readv/write/pwrite/writev; not direct syscalls; includes codec file traffic
counter_scopes.new: C++ global throwing new/new[], including aligned; requested bytes, not live bytes; C malloc/system allocations excluded
counter_scopes.rss: whole process high-water RSS, includes initialization and correctness validation
counter_scopes.sampling: counts, RSS, backend/libc/codec metrics from one separate instrumented diagnostic execution per scenario/revision; excluded from five timing samples

environment.cache_policy: normal OS caches; no cache dropping

host_limit: No exclusive quiet established. Pre-window CPU idle 42–58%; user granted go after temporary uploader-pause instructions. Temporary stores outside synced Desktop. No repeat campaign.
order: baseline,candidate repeated five times per scenario
